note: Lava-lamp observer-band response surface. It maps the lower-stage Geant4 density descriptor plus lamp temperature/aspect context to the parameters consumed by the deterministic 10-minute blob replay: cycle period, vertical excursion, cohesion, and inter-blob phase heterogeneity. This is an ILLUSTRATIVE portable response surface, not a held-out-validated lava-lamp surrogate; its uncertainty is emitted and widening it with measured wax/carrier/heater panels is tracked in ROADMAP.md. No reference trajectory or fixed animation target is loaded at runtime.
